answer.reason: The harness prints only trees returned by parsing. Parsing and printing start at depth zero, and both parsing and printing reject array or object nodes at the same nesting threshold. A parser-produced object cannot reach the new print guard at a rejected depth. The complete harness also has no assertion that printing returns a non-NULL value.

feasible_trigger.reason: No finite input can make this harness print a parser-produced object at a depth the new object printer rejects. Container parsing dispatches through guards using the same threshold, and both parse and print depth start at zero.

observable_consequence.reason: The claimed depth-only print failure cannot occur for this entry's parser-produced objects. Independently, the complete harness tolerates a NULL print result and contains no assertion about print success.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: Parser-accepted object depths remain reachable through the harness's buffered and unbuffered print routes. Array printing also counts mixed nesting with the same limit, so nesting through arrays does not create a blocked route.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—printing a parser-produced object at a parser-accepted depth—is assessed against the same harness before and after. The old object printer has no depth guard; the new guard matches the parser threshold.
